projects.title: THUMBNAIL BEFORE AND AFTER
projects.description: YouTube Thumbnail Redesign Redesigned a low-performing thumbnail to enhance clarity, visual hierarchy, and click-through potential. The updated version leverages bold typography, high-contrast visuals, and expressive imagery to create a stronger hook and immediate viewer engagement. Strategic use of composition, product focus, and attention-directing elements results in a cleaner, more impactful, and performance-driven design. Focus: CTR optimization, visual storytelling, and high-conversion thumbnail design
